opportunities.title: Small Grants – UK – September 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to, or provide evidence of support from, an organisation or institution that is willing to receive grant funds. Applications are not accepted from individuals seeking support for personal projects, though the UK office may consider applications from individuals who can provide proof of organisational support.
opportunities.summary: Seed funding for UK‑Japan collaborative projects across arts and culture, humanities, social issues, Japanese language, medicine and health, science, youth and education, and sport.

opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards – December 2026

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health‑related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference is given to those without prior UK‑Japan collaboration experience and early‑career researchers.
opportunities.summary: Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
